one_line: A 13th‑century Kakatiya nayaka commander whose military service and temple patronage exemplify the fluid land‑for‑service honor networks of Warangal and its mandalas.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, lean but well-muscled, upright warrior posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a medium-brown Telangana complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, neatly trimmed moustache, intense almond-shaped eyes with a focused, confident gaze and a calm, authoritative default expression.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair, pulled back into a short, tidy warrior topknot tied with a narrow red cloth band; simple golden circular stud earrings in both ears and no crown or elaborate headgear.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate 13th-century Kakatiya commander attire: over a cream cotton short-sleeved tunic reaching mid-thigh, he wears a deep indigo-blue fitted sleeveless cloth vest reinforced with subtly visible leather strips at the shoulders; a rust-red cotton dhoti is wrapped securely around the hips and legs in a northern Andhra/Telangana style, pleats drawn up to allow movement and falling to the ankles, with a thin darker red border; a long mustard-yellow cotton angavastra is draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, its ends hanging near the right hip; simple brown leather belt at the waist holding a small pouch; minimal armour consisting of brown leather bracers on both forearms and a single leather-and-metal circular pauldron on his left shoulder; feet in brown leather sandals with thong straps; a narrow beaded necklace of dull gold and black beads and a small cylindrical copper talisman pendant rests at the base of his neck.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Kakatiya-style steel sword with a plain iron cross-guard and a brown leather-wrapped hilt, worn at his left hip in a dark brown leather scabbard and often held lightly in one hand to suggest readiness and authority.

ref_desc: Malyala Gunda Senani is a lean early-30s Kakatiya commander with medium-brown skin, black topknot, cream tunic, indigo vest, rust-red dhoti, mustard-yellow angavastra, light leather armour, and a curved steel sword at his left hip in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style 13th-century Kakatiya commander, Malyala Gunda Senani, standing confident and upright: medium-brown Telangana complexion, oval face, sharp jaw, neat moustache, intense almond eyes, and black hair pulled into a short warrior topknot tied with a red band and simple gold stud earrings. Show his historically grounded costume clearly: a cream cotton short-sleeved tunic to mid-thigh under a deep indigo-blue sleeveless vest, visibly reinforced with subtle leather strips at the shoulders; a rust-red cotton dhoti wrapped securely, pleated for movement and falling to the ankles, with a thin darker red border; and a long mustard-yellow angavastra draped from left shoulder across chest and back, hanging near the right hip. Add a plain brown leather belt with a small pouch, brown leather forearm bracers, and a single leather-and-metal circular pauldron on his left shoulder, keeping the armour modest and practical, not fantastical. Put brown leather sandals on his feet and a narrow beaded necklace of dull gold and black beads with a small copper talisman at his neck. At his left hip, show a slightly curved Kakatiya-style steel sword with simple iron cross-guard in a dark brown leather scabbard; he lightly rests one hand on the hilt or holds the sword in a relaxed but ready pose. Use a palette dominated by medium brown skin, indigo blue, rust red, mustard yellow, cream, and brown leather tones, with clear, clean lines so this design can be redrawn consistently across panels.
